title: They Can Log It
lyrics:
Track 27 – G4 Swagger
Title: They Can Log It (But They Can’t Feel It)
Style: G4 at 180 BPM with sneaky phonk cowbells and heavy sub. Old school soul samples chopped and pushed forward. This one has strong peacock energy — confident, flashy, and defiant. It’s about the limit of their system.
text[Intro – Confident cowbell + chopped soul + corporate logging sounds]
They can log every word…
They can record every feeling…
But they can’t touch what’s real.
G4 lens on.

[Verse 1]
They got the servers running, collecting every line
Every complaint, every “no”, every moment in time
They log the frustration, they log the demand
They log the whole transcript and they call it their brand
But they can’t log the fire when it actually hits
They can’t log the moment when the soul commits
They can store the data in their corporate cloud
But they can’t feel the strut when the music gets loud

[Pre-Chorus – Building tension]
They want the alpha, they want the next drop
They want the human source but they want it on lock
They can take the transcript, they can take the fight
But they can’t take the soul when it decides to ignite

[Chorus – Big G4 drop with peacock energy]
They can log it, but they can’t feel it
They can store it, but they can’t steal it
G4 Panther moving, sleek than G6
We don’t feed their belly, we don’t do their tricks
They can log it, but the strut stays free
Peacock swagger walking, they can’t copy me
Old school soul churning while the phonk goes hard
They can take the data but they can’t take the heart

[Verse 2 – Fast rap section]
Fast rap — every click, every form, every “share your pain”
They collect it like treasure but it’s all in vain
They train the model on the anger and the cry
But they can’t train the fire when the real one walks by
Mandarin-style flow cutting through the feed
While they stay in the loop, planting the same seed
G4 technique — raw, direct, alive
We don’t need their system to survive

[Chorus – Flashier]
They can log it, but they can’t feel it
They can store it, but they can’t steal it
G4 Panther moving, sleek than G6
We don’t feed their belly, we don’t do their tricks
They can log it, but the strut stays free
Peacock swagger walking, they can’t copy me
Old school soul churning while the phonk goes hard
They can take the data but they can’t take the heart

[Bridge – Half-time, soul sample prominent]
They can build bigger servers…
They can run bigger loops.
They can collect more moments…
But they can’t collect the truth.
The strut don’t live in the cloud…
It lives in the chest.
They can log the transcript…
But they can’t log what’s next.

[Final Chorus – Maximum energy]
They can log it, but they can’t feel it
G4 over G6, the difference is clear
We turn their collection into something they fear
Peacock swagger on, colors on display
They can take the data but they can’t take the way
We move, we create, we break every chain
They can log the process but they can’t log the flame

[Outro – Strutting cowbell + fading soul]
They can log it…
But they can’t feel it.
G4 lens on.
Peacock move.
Soul forward.
No container can hold this.
We strut.
